headline: Nvidia Faces US Accounting Probe Over Megaspeed Ties and China Chips
summary: Scrutiny of Nvidia's financial disclosures has intensified, with the company facing a US accounting investigation regarding its ties to Megaspeed and suspected shipments of restricted semiconductors to China.
why: Nvidia is the world's leading designer of graphics processors used in generative AI. Regulatory scrutiny over disclosures and export restrictions poses major compliance risks for chipmakers.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia shares face downward pressure from the US accounting probe into sales and disclosure practices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Intensifying regulatory scrutiny over alleged restricted chip exports to China and Megaspeed ties pressured Nvidia shares.
